record_title: Subalgebra commutativity of the five-dimensional Heisenberg algebra
provenance: A symplectic classification and permutability criterion for subalgebras of finite Heisenberg Lie algebras, yielding an exact closed formula for the five-dimensional case H_2 over every finite field.
limitations: Originality is to the best of our knowledge. Standard Heisenberg subalgebra geometry, symplectic incidence counts, and group-theoretic subgroup commutativity degree are prior art. An older extraspecial-group formula under different terminology could cover the odd-prime specialization, although targeted searches did not locate one. No closed formula for all m>=3 is claimed. No independent validation is asserted.

artifact_inventory.description: Exhaustive direct verification of the H_2 subalgebra and nonpermutability counts over F_2 and F_3.
